method: Means, medians, MAD, Tukey flags, paired percentage changes, fixed-seed 20,000-resample exploratory bootstrap and outlier sensitivity. Every trial retained.

workloads.caveat: 15 paired trials give an exploratory interval. Outlier flags are descriptive; no sample is removed from headline results. This does not quantify unrelated background load or prove all workloads improve.
